Author: Monk Layout contributors
Name: Monk & White Mage Layouts
Punchline: Compact level 100 Monk and White Mage HUD and keyboard presets.
Description: One-time keyboard and mouse setup. Monk uses HUD 4; White Mage uses HUD 3 with a centered lily gauge and nearby party list. Fills the selected job's hotbars 1-3 and optionally sets keyboard bindings. Separate local backups and restore for each job. Open /monklayout or /whmlayout.
Changelog: Adds a level 100 White Mage preset with 35 actions, 32 keyboard shortcuts, a healer-focused HUD 3 and its own backup. Retains the compact Monk HUD 4 and supports backups created by previous versions.
